significance.root_decision: Conjecture 1 of Gow and McGuire is false. Over F = F_3(t) the 3-polynomial L = X^81 + (t + t^2) X^27 - (t + t^2) X^9 + (t + t^2) X^3 - t (t^2 + t + 1) X has 3-degree 4, L/X is irreducible over F, L is not a 3^s-polynomial for any s > 1, and r = 2 <= q - 1, yet the evaluation map epsilon_2 on quadratic forms in a basis of the root space is not injective: an explicit seven-term quadratic form vanishes on the roots (the image has dimension 8 in a space of dimension 10). The roots are the image of u F_81, with u^80 = t, under the additive twist x -> x + x^3 of the Kummer polynomial X^81 - tX; the twist keeps irreducibility, because the automorphisms u -> cu act transitively on the nonzero roots, and it forces the kernel. Lean states the conjecture for q = p = 3 with every hypothesis of the source and proves its negation with this witness, including irreducibility and the splitting field.
significance.caveat: Bounded literature search only; the source exists only as an arXiv preprint (no journal version found). The Lean statement of the conjecture is its specialization to q = p = 3, with all hypotheses of the source; refuting that special case refutes the conjecture. Cross-model confidence: correct 0.98, not public 0.85, not routine 0.65, Lean statement 0.97; overall about 0.6 that a specialist accepts it as more than an exercise, the risk being that additive twisting looks natural once suggested. A plain search would not find it: finite base fields are covered by the source's Theorem 12 and the mechanism needs n >= 4. Whether the conjecture fails for n = 3 is not settled.
